towns.name: Bluespire
towns.summary: Bluespire (39.4N 75.3W) is the human 'spire town' in the marshes at the southern end of the Karab Delta on Marae Lassel, shared by Isparian shopkeepers and Aun Tumeroks until the Viamontians took it in the Under Cover of Night event and immediately raised a stronghold - the gold-roofed stone tower in the middle of town. The town lies flat on mud at sea level between delta channels and the eastern sea, with tall delta trees (to 32 m) on the east bank. Bamboo-and-thatch Aun houses, a spire-roofed hall and an octagonal Aun hall are lit by big blue-flame braziers; beside the tower a great Viamontian banner-sword crackles with Virindi-style energy (mist, lightning and orbs), next to the Life Stone and the Town Network portal. The Viamontian Laboratory dungeon entrance (interior, not filmed) is in town, and a lightning-crackling destroyed portal to Holtburg stands on the southern shore.
